call_points.text: AUM crossed ₹1.24 lakh Cr, up 38% YoY, driven by strong core lending in gold, home loans, MSME, and microfinance.
Consolidated PAT reached ₹805 Cr, crossing the ₹800 Cr milestone for the first time.
Management expects home loans and secured MSME lending to gain momentum as gold loan growth moderates.
Loan losses and provisions fell 44% YoY to ₹280.8 Cr in Q2FY27.
Off-book assignment and co-lending book reached ₹42,796 Cr with 18 active bank co-lending partners.
Completed a ₹25 Cr tokenised bond, the first by a non-PSU NBFC in India.
US$300mn social bond tap issue was ~2.3x oversubscribed with a 3.5-year tenor.
Samasta microfinance ROA targeted at 2.5-3%, closer to 3% by year-end.
Parent capital adequacy is "at the edge"; options include QIP, subsidiary stake sale, perpetual debt and co-lending.
Board approved an enabling resolution for fresh equity, subject to shareholder approval at the AGM.
Unsecured business loans and personal loans have been discontinued; LAP and secured MSME remain the new products.
Gold loan margins seen stable despite competition; new players aggressive on yield and LTV.
Housing finance incremental yields up 68-70 bps, but portfolio yield fell as high-yield micro LAP runs off.
Gold loan 30-plus DPD at 3.8%; management called the rise marginal and seasonal, with near-zero historical LGD.
Income tax demand of ₹475 Cr under appeal with CIT; no new development.
Sale-of-receipts book to be fully wound up by September 2027, with recovery expected above book value.
Gold loan AUM is expected to grow at 20% to 25% in FY27 if gold prices remain stable.
Credit cost for FY27 is guided to be around 1.5% to 1.7%, declining from previous levels.

operating_notes.text: Re-assessed FY25 GNPA to ₹645.85 Cr and NNPA to ₹498.62 Cr following NHB advisory alignment on cheque realization.
Recognized ₹20.10 Cr incremental gratuity impact on account of four New Labour Codes.
IIFL Fintech approved the acquisition of an 87.8% stake in Xtracap Fintech India Private Limited for ₹37.7 Cr.
Loan AUM crossed ₹1 lakh crore, reaching ₹1,08,180 Cr in Q4FY26.
Finance Committee approved up to 200 perpetual NCDs of ₹1 crore face value each (₹200 Cr total), callable only after 10 years with RBI approval.
Brickwork reaffirmed BWR AA+/Stable on ₹3,022.04 Cr of NCDs and BWR AA/Stable on ₹650 Cr PDI, and assigned BWR AA/Stable to a proposed ₹200 Cr PDI.
Allotted 100 perpetual unsecured NCDs of ₹1 crore each aggregating to ₹100 Cr at 9.90% p.a. coupon.
Priced USD 500 million fixed rate senior secured notes at 7.60% p.a. maturing September 10, 2029.
Gold loan AUM grew 11% QoQ in Q1FY27, of which 5-6% was tonnage growth; LTV around 70%.
Assigned loan book ₹26,118 Cr (up 73% YoY) and co-lending assets ₹14,647 Cr (up 27% YoY); 15 active bank partners for co-lending.
Housing finance micro LAP book ₹440 Cr and BLC book ₹260 Cr are the main GNPA contributors to be cleaned up.
Gross NPA 1.48% and net NPA 0.87% at September 2026; specific provision coverage 41.28%.
Net gearing ratio 4.87x and debt service coverage ratio 4.08 for H1FY27.
Issued USD 300 million 7.60% senior secured notes due 2030 on July 10, 2026.
Gold loan AUM ₹65,729 Cr at Q2FY27, 52.9% of consolidated AUM, with gold tonnage of 69.3 MT and GNPA of 0.90%.
Off-book assignment and co-lending book ₹42,796 Cr at Q2FY27, 34% of consolidated AUM, across 18 active bank co-lending partners.
Completed a ₹25 Cr tokenised bond transaction on the MSEI framework under the SEBI Regulatory Sandbox, described as the first by a non-PSU NBFC.
Gold loan AUM stood at ₹65,729 Cr, accounting for 52.9% of consolidated AUM.

timeline.summary: IIFL Finance Limited’s **Samrat Sanyal** (ACS-13863) schedules earnings call on **April 29, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST** to discuss Q4 FY2025-26 and FY2025-26 financials.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹3,692.5 Cr (+42.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹586.84 Cr (+182.6% YoY).
IIFL Finance announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary IIFL Fintech agreed to acquire an 87.8% stake in Xtracap Fintech for ₹37.7 Cr.
On 7 May 2026, IIFL Finance filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings call held on April 29, 2026, reporting loan AUM crossing ₹1.08 lakh Cr.
On 13 May 2026, IIFL Finance announced the repurchase and cancellation of USD 12.62 million of its Senior Secured Fixed Rate Notes due 2028.

On 15 May 2026, IIFL Finance's Finance Committee approved terms for up to ₹200 Cr of listed, unsecured, perpetual non-convertible debentures on private placement, callable after 10 years with RBI approval.
On May 16, 2026, IIFL Finance disclosed an RBI penalty of ₹3.10 lakh for gold auction surplus distribution lapses in FY2025.
IIFL Finance announced credit rating reaffirmations and assignments from Brickwork Ratings and Infomerics on May 16, 2026.
On May 29, 2026, IIFL Finance allotted ₹100 Cr of perpetual unsecured NCDs at a 9.90% coupon.
IIFL Finance scheduled institutional investor meetings from June 1 to 5, 2026.
IIFL Finance priced USD 500 million of senior secured notes at 7.60% due September 2029 under its GMTN programme.
S&P Global Ratings assigned a B+ rating to IIFL Finance's USD 500 million senior secured notes.

On its 22 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, IIFL Finance reported AUM up 38% YoY to ₹1,15,523 Cr, ROE of 19.5% and gross NPA of 1.6%, and said parent capital adequacy is at the edge with an enabling equity resolution before shareholders.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,246.45 Cr (+28.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹766.42 Cr (+103.7% YoY).
Q2FY27 (15 Oct 2026): IIFL Finance reported consolidated PAT (pre-NCI) of ₹805.0 Cr, up 93% YoY, on AUM of ₹1,24,268 Cr, up 38% YoY, with GNPA at 1.48%; Fitch upgraded it to BB-.
IIFL Finance reported Q2FY27 consolidated AUM of ₹1,24,268 Cr and PAT of ₹805 Cr, with GNPA improving to 1.48%.
